jobs.title: Vice President, Reporting & Analytics Product Development
jobs.description:
ADP is hiring a Vice President, Reporting & Analytics Product Development

Are you energized by the challenge of transforming complex data into intuitive experiences that help millions of people make better decisions?
Do you have the vision and technical depth to bring reporting, analytics, insights, and AI together into a seamless, integrated experience?
Do you lead with empathy for clients, associates, and partners while making bold decisions and navigating complexity?
Are you a technologist at heart who builds high-performing, diverse teams and inspires engineering excellence and innovation?

ADP is seeking a Vice President of Reporting & Analytics Product Development to lead the strategy, engineering, and delivery of ADP’s enterprise Reporting and Analytics platform.

Data is at the center of every organization’s most important workforce decisions. Clients need more than traditional reports and disconnected analytics tools—they need an integrated experience that makes it easy to access trusted data, understand what is happening, uncover why it is happening, and determine what action to take next.

This executive will lead the evolution of ADP’s Reporting and Analytics capabilities into a unified, intelligent data experience embedded across ADP’s global Human Capital Management solutions. The platform will bring together operational reporting, dashboards, visualization, advanced analytics, benchmarking, natural-language exploration, and AI-powered insights—enabling clients to move seamlessly from a business question to a trusted answer and, ultimately, to informed action.

The VP will be responsible for the technology vision, architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this strategic platform. The role requires a leader who can modernize a large-scale global platform while continuing to deliver reliable capabilities to clients who depend on ADP every day.

The VP will lead a global, diverse, multidisciplinary organization spanning software engineering, data engineering, architecture, user experience, quality engineering, and production operations. This leader will work closely with Product Management, Data Science, AI, Security, Infrastructure, and ADP Business Unit leaders to create a common platform that meets the unique needs of ADP’s HCM products while delivering a consistent and integrated client experience.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Leadership: Help shape ADP’s enterprise data, reporting, analytics, and AI strategy, ensuring technology investments align with client needs, business priorities, and ADP’s long-term growth objectives.
Unified Reporting and Analytics Vision: Lead the creation of an integrated experience that brings together reporting, dashboards, visualization, analytics, benchmarking, insights, and AI-powered exploration. Enable users to move naturally from understanding what happened to why it happened, what may happen next, and what action they should take.
Platform Strategy and Roadmap: Partner with Product Management and Business Unit leaders to define and execute a multiyear platform roadmap, including modernization priorities, shared capabilities, adoption milestones, and measurable business outcomes.
Enterprise Platform Development: Build reusable, scalable platform services that can be embedded across ADP’s HCM products while accommodating differences in data models, client segments, geographies, regulatory environments, and user needs.
Reporting Modernization: Evolve traditional reporting capabilities into a modern, intuitive, self-service experience that simplifies report creation, improves discoverability, reduces complexity, and enables clients to access trusted information more quickly.
Analytics and Insights: Expand the platform’s capabilities beyond traditional reporting to include interactive analytics, visual exploration, benchmarking, forecasting, recommendations, and actionable workforce insights.
AI and Agentic Experiences: Advance the use of generative and agentic AI to allow clients and associates to interact with data using natural language. Ensure AI-generated answers are accurate, explainable, appropriately governed, and grounded in trusted enterprise data.
Semantic Data Strategy: Lead the development of a common semantic layer that translates complex HCM data into consistent business concepts, metrics, and relationships. Ensure that reporting, analytics, and AI experiences use common definitions and deliver consistent answers.
Engineering Excellence: Build and mentor a world-class engineering organization focused on scalable architecture, secure development, automation, observability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.
Architecture and Technology Strategy: Establish the architecture for a cloud-enabled, API-first, metadata-driven Reporting and Analytics platform capable of supporting large data volumes, complex queries, global scale, and near-real-time experiences.
Data Trust, Governance, and Security: Partner with enterprise data, privacy, legal, and security leaders to ensure appropriate data lineage, access controls, auditability, retention, privacy, residency, and regulatory compliance. Build client confidence by making insights transparent, explainable, and traceable to trusted sources.
Client Experience: Champion an intuitive, accessible, and consistent experience across ADP products. Apply user-centered design principles to reduce complexity and make sophisticated data capabilities usable by practitioners, managers, executives, analysts, and employees.
Business Unit Partnership: Collaborate with leaders across ADP’s businesses to understand product-specific needs, establish shared priorities, drive adoption, and balance enterprise standardization with differentiated market requirements.
Customer and Market Alignment: Engage with clients, prospects, Sales, Service, Implementation, and Marketing to understand evolving needs, validate platform direction, and identify opportunities to strengthen ADP’s competitive position.
Operational Excellence: Maintain a high standard of platform availability, performance, resilience, and supportability. Establish service-level objectives, proactive monitoring, capacity planning, and disciplined incident and problem-management practices.
Product and Delivery Execution: Lead all phases of development—from discovery and architecture through implementation, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement—while maintaining transparency around progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.
Quality and Compliance: Establish comprehensive quality engineering practices that include automated testing, performance validation, security testing, data-quality controls, accessibility, and regulatory compliance.
Value Realization: Define and measure outcomes such as client adoption, time to insight, report completion time, platform performance, client satisfaction, support-effort reduction, implementation efficiency, and revenue enablement.
Risk Management: Proactively identify architectural, operational, security, data, delivery, and adoption risks. Work across organizational boundaries to resolve issues before they affect clients or strategic commitments.
Talent and Organizational Leadership: Attract, develop, and retain exceptional global talent. Create an inclusive, accountable culture in which leaders and associates understand the mission, collaborate effectively, and are empowered to deliver meaningful outcomes.
Innovation and Continuous Learning: Promote experimentation, technical upskilling, and the responsible adoption of emerging technologies. Create a culture that balances innovation and speed with the reliability, security, and trust required of an enterprise HCM platform.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced experience is preferred.
At least 15 years of progressive experience in software or product development, including 5–8+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing large, global, multidisciplinary organizations.
Demonstrated experience developing and operating enterprise-scale reporting, business intelligence, analytics, data, or AI platforms.
Proven success modernizing complex platforms while maintaining continuity, reliability, and performance for existing clients.
Deep understanding of modern data architectures, semantic models, metadata management, APIs, cloud platforms, data pipelines, analytical processing, visualization, and distributed systems.
Experience delivering integrated reporting and analytics experiences across multiple products, business units, client segments, or geographic markets.
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural-language interfaces, and agentic architectures, including the governance and controls required to deliver accurate and explainable AI-powered insights.
Strong understanding of data governance, privacy, security, lineage, access control, regulatory compliance, and responsible AI practices.
Proven record of leading globally distributed engineering teams and delivering secure, highly scalable, available, and resilient enterprise software.
Experience overseeing end-to-end production operations, including service reliability, observability, performance management, incident response, capacity planning, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and align stakeholders across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Security, Sales, Marketing, Service, Implementation, and Customer Success.
Experience in Human Capital Management, Enterprise Resource Planning, financial technology, or another domain that manages complex, sensitive, and highly regulated enterprise data is strongly preferred.

Leadership Capabilities

Strategic Thinking: Develops and executes a compelling long-term vision while translating strategy into clear priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
Technology Leadership: Demonstrates the technical judgment to guide architecture, evaluate emerging technologies, and make sound decisions regarding modernization, scale, security, and platform sustainability.
Client-Centric Innovation: Begins with the client problem and creates simple, trusted experiences from complex technology and data ecosystems.
Data-Driven Decision-Making: Uses quantitative and qualitative evidence to establish priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, measure progress, and adapt strategy.
Enterprise Collaboration: Builds alignment across organizational boundaries and balances the needs of individual businesses with the benefits of shared enterprise capabilities.
Transformation Leadership: Leads effectively through ambiguity, establishes clarity amid complexity, and sustains momentum through multiyear organizational and technology transformation.
Operational Discipline: Maintains a relentless focus on quality, reliability, performance, security, and the client experience.
Talent Development: Builds strong leadership teams, develops future leaders, creates inclusive environments, and holds the organization accountable for both results and behaviors.

This is an opportunity to lead one of ADP’s most strategic technology platforms and redefine how clients interact with workforce data. The successful candidate will help create a future in which reporting and analytics are no longer separate activities, but part of one connected, intelligent experience—making it easier for every user to ask a question, receive a trusted answer, understand its meaning, and take informed action.

Foxx Development Inc. is a leading consumer electronics and IoT solutions firm dedicated to providing innovative products and services to enhance the connectivity and convenience of modern lifestyles. With a focus on cutting-edge technology and user-centric design, we strive not only to deliver products but also revolutionize the way people interact with their environments.

Position Summary:

FOXX Development Inc. is seeking a SVP of Product Management to lead the Company’s overall product strategy, product management, product planning, digital operations/digital transformation and commercialization activities across its mobile devices, carrier, Lifeline, AI/IoT, and strategic product businesses. The SVP of Product Management will serve as the primary executive owner of the Company’s product roadmap and product execution, connecting customer and market requirements with Sales, Carrier Business, R&D, Engineering, ODM/OEM partners, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations. This role is expected to ensure that FOXX develops the right products for the right customers and markets, while driving products from initial business requirements through development, certification, launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The SVP of Product Management will work closely with the EVP/Sales leadership. While the EVP organization primarily focuses on customer development, carrier relationships, strategic accounts, partnerships, and revenue generation, the SVP of Product Management will own the product strategy, product readiness, and execution required to convert those opportunities into commercially viable products and programs.

1. Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

Define and maintain FOXX’s overall product strategy, portfolio priorities, and product roadmap.
Evaluate product opportunities based on customer demand, market potential, competitive landscape, technical feasibility, investment requirements, and expected commercial return.
Establish clear priorities across existing and emerging product categories, including: Carrier devices and programs; Lifeline products; Open-market devices; Strategic AI-enabled products; IoT and other emerging product opportunities.

Develop and maintain product business cases, including target pricing, product cost, margin expectations, development investment, volume assumptions, and expected ROI.
Establish product lifecycle and portfolio review processes to determine when products should be launched, expanded, repositioned, or discontinued.
Establish a structured voice-of-customer and competitive intelligence process to ensure product roadmap decisions are grounded in customer needs, market trends, competitive offerings, and emerging technologies.

2. Carrier & Customer Product Management

Serve as the executive product interface between FOXX’s commercial organization and internal/external development resources.
Translate carrier and strategic customer requirements into clear product requirements and execution plans.

Partner closely with EVP/Sales and Carrier Business teams on: Carrier product opportunities; RFP/RFQ responses; Product positioning; Product specifications; Certification requirements; Launch readiness; Commercialization planning.
Ensure customer commitments are aligned with actual technical capability, development timelines, cost, and operational readiness.

3. Product Development & R&D Alignment

Provide business and product direction to R&D and engineering teams based on market and customer priorities.
Establish clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), product specifications, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinate internal R&D resources and external ODM/OEM partners to ensure product development remains aligned with commercial objectives.
Participate in major product architecture, feature, platform, and supplier decisions from a product and business perspective.
Identify gaps between customer requirements and existing supplier/R&D capabilities and develop appropriate solutions.

The VP of Product Management is not intended to replace the technical leadership of R&D or Engineering; rather, the VP of Product Management defines what should be built, for whom, why, and when, while technical teams determine how the product is engineered and implemented.

GridBeats™ DvM is a powerful software suite enabling remote monitoring, control, and lifecycle management of grid intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) — including protection relays, fault recorders, power quality meters, and sensing equipment. The VP will be responsible for the technology vision, architecture, development, delivery, and operation of this strategic platform. The role requires a leader who can modernize a large-scale global platform while continuing to deliver reliable capabilities to clients who depend on ADP every day.

The VP will lead a global, diverse, multidisciplinary organization spanning software engineering, data engineering, architecture, user experience, quality engineering, and production operations. Executive Leadership: Help shape ADP’s enterprise data, reporting, analytics, and AI strategy, ensuring technology investments align with client needs, business priorities, and ADP’s long-term growth objectives.

Engineering Excellence: Build and mentor a world-class engineering organization focused on scalable architecture, secure development, automation, observability, maintainability, and continuous improvement.

About DEUNA 🧡

DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNA—the fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin America—ATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.

With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexico’s digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.

We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! 🚀

Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Management Head for Deuna's core payments product organization. This role is responsible for defining the long-term vision, strategy, and execution across multiple product pillars within our payments platform. You will lead a team of Product Managers while owning the overall business success, scalability, and innovation of this product area.

As a Product Management Head, you will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering leadership, and business impact, shaping the future of our payment orchestration and capabilities platform. You will be responsible for turning complex payment infrastructure challenges into scalable product solutions while ensuring the organization stays aligned on long-term goals.

Who You Are

10+ years of experience in Product Management
Experience leading multiple product teams or managing Product Managers
Strong background in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure platforms
Deep understanding of payment ecosystems including: Payment orchestration, PSP/acquirer integrations, Payment methods and wallets, Disputes and chargebacks, Subscription and recurring payments
Experience building and scaling API-driven platforms
Strong collaboration with engineering teams on complex systems
Experience leading large cross-team initiatives
Strong strategic thinking and ability to define long-term product direction
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Advanced or native-level English

What You'll Do

Product Vision & Strategy

Define and lead the multi-year product vision (3+ years) for our payments ecosystem
Identify major new product opportunities within the evolving payments landscape
Drive strategic direction across multiple product pillars and initiatives
Align product strategy with company growth, revenue objectives, and market expansion

Organizational Leadership

Lead and develop a team of Product Managers responsible for key product areas
Define team structure, hiring plans, and career development for product leaders
Establish strong product management standards and operating processes
Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and innovation

Payments Platform Leadership

Drive the evolution of our payments orchestration platform and capabilities layer
Ensure the platform supports critical payment workflows including:
Payment connectivity
Payment orchestration
Reconciliation and financial operations
Subscriptions and recurring payments
Disputes and chargeback management

Ensure product architecture supports enterprise-scale merchants and high transaction volumes

Cross-Functional Impact

Partner closely with Engineering leadership to define scalable technical architecture
Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships to translate market needs into product strategy
Remove organizational blockers and drive alignment across teams
Lead cross-team initiatives that span multiple product areas

Business Ownership

Own the business performance of the payments product area
Define success metrics and product KPIs tied to growth, merchant adoption, and platform performance
Ensure product decisions balance customer value, scalability, and business outcomes

Market & Innovation

Continuously evaluate emerging trends in the payments ecosystem
Identify opportunities related to orchestration, approval optimization, financial automation, and AI-driven payment intelligence
Position our product platform as a leader in enterprise payments infrastructure

What will you find when you join DEUNA?

A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM
Dynamism, agility and constant innovation
Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region
The best tools and technology to operate
Being part of the startup culture
We are in full expansion!

Vacations and additional PTO 🏝️

Remote work from anywhere 💻

Economic support for health insurance, internet and cell phone line📱🌐

We all own DEUNA, we offer stock options 💸

Learning and development platform 📚

Multidisciplinary, diverse and dynamic team 🧡

Growth and career path 🚀

Be part of a dynamic team that's creating the next generation payments platform.
